name: Z1 Drill & Cutout G-code
description: Generate Makera Z1 g-code to drill holes and cut the board outline
description_full: Emits a single Makera Z1 (Carvera/Smoothieware) g-code program that drills the board's through-holes and cuts the outline to size, with an in-program manual tool change between the two. Intended for a split workflow where a UV laser ablates copper and solder mask and the mill only does the through-cutting work. Geometry comes straight from the pcbnew API -- no Gerbers, no pcb2gcode, no external tools. Holes are helically milled, the outline is offset by the cutter radius with holding tabs, and everything is referenced to the drill/place origin.
